# Driftline

> Driftline helps Product Marketing and RevOps turn verified promise changes into owner-ready, reversible work.

## Product

Driftline reads a registered source, cites the observed change, maps affected work surfaces and owners, and pauses for human approval. Public examples are preview-only and do not write to external systems.

## Evidence and safety

Every recommendation stays linked to its source evidence. Approval is explicit, outputs are reversible, and technical release proof is available in the product's Technical proof disclosure.
